artworks.title: Pentecost
artworks.description: A group of people are sitting together with a dove above them. The scene depicts various figures gathered closely, seated and looking upwards towards a central point from which rays of light emanate. Above them, a dove is prominently positioned in the center, with light streaming downwards, creating a focal point. The figures are shown in expressive postures, some with hands raised, others in contemplative poses, and all appearing to be engaged in a shared experience. The clothing and style suggest a historical or religious context, lending a sense of reverence to the scene.

artworks.title: Pentecost
artworks.description: The image shows a group of individuals seated in a circular arrangement, displaying their entire bodies. The central figure sits with her hands in a prayer position, surrounded by mostly men who are seated and oriented towards one another. Each person is dressed in flowing garments resembling classical robes, with some figures appearing to have halos or tongues of flame above their heads. They have a range of facial hair and hairstyles. Above them hovers a dove radiating light, casting streams of light downwards towards the seated figures. The background is minimally detailed, emphasizing the beams of light fanning outwards from the dove, creating an ethereal atmosphere around the gathering.

artworks.title: Venus and Mars Embracing with Vulcan at his Forge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior scene depicting mythological elements. The image shows figures in various poses within the setting. On the left, figures are draped on a bed with decorative drapery. The central figure is at a forge engaged in smithing activities, surrounded by flames and tools. The room has patterned floors, a decorative window, and a large basin in the foreground. The drawing showcases detailed human forms, line work, and shading.

artworks.title: Venus Reclining with Vulcan at His Forge
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a workshop scene. There is a figure reclining on a bed with heavy drapery, and another figure working at a forge. The reclining figure is draped in fabrics and resting on cushions. The background includes curtains, ornate bedding, and a tiled floor. The working figure is muscular, focused on hammering at an anvil. Flames in the background suggest heat from the forge. The drawing includes a pitcher, basin, and sculptural elements in the workspace.

artworks.title: Madonna and Child Enthroned, Saint Jerome and Saint Francis
artworks.artist: Anton Maria Zanetti I, after Parmigianino
artworks.medium: color chiaroscuro woodcut on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows three figures in an elaborate scene. In the center, a woman is seated holding a child on her lap. The woman has a serene expression, styled hair, and wears a long robe. The child is naked. To the left of the woman, a man kneels looking up at her, wearing a robe with a cross. To the right of the woman, another figure stands reading a book, with a beard and wearing a robe. The background is detailed with architectural elements, a cloudy sky, and foliage. A skull and a cross are near the central pedestal.

artworks.title: Diana and Her Nymphs in a Garden
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: diameter (trimmed to borderline, with part of image lost at upper right): 19.6 cm (7 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: The circular drawing depicts various figures in flowing robes surrounded by trees and clouds. A central reclining figure lies on the ground, while other figures interact nearby. One figure gestures towards a small animal, possibly a dog, sniffing the ground. In the background, more figures walk among the trees. Above them, a seated figure is depicted in the clouds. The landscape includes sparse vegetation and a distant vista with more figures, clouds, and mountains. The style is reminiscent of Renaissance engravings, with detailed line work and an emphasis on classical forms and symmetry.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: The image depicts two figures. The figure on the left is seated and facing slightly towards the right. She has a serene facial expression with her eyes downcast. Her hair is covered with a veil and she is wearing a long gown. The environment includes a bench or pedestal she is seated on and an open book nearby. The figure on the right is kneeling on the ground, facing the seated figure. This person has wavy hair falling to their shoulders and wings attached to their back. They hold a long stem with flowers in one hand. In the background, there are clouds and rays of light emanating from a central point where a dove is depicted, surrounded by several small cherubic figures with wings. The background engraving portrays cherubs and bearded figures within the clouds.

artworks.title: The Group at the Fireplace
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an indoor setting. The scene is dimly lit, with no visible people. The drawing shows furniture in the room, with shadows and contrasts created by intricate cross-hatching. The strokes and details depict the mood of the space with an expressive style. The overall tone is subdued yet rich with texture.

artworks.title: The Smoker
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure engaged in a task. The image is rendered in fine black lines with cross-hatching for depth. The figure is seated on a wooden chair with one foot resting on a low platform. They wear loose clothing and a hat partially covers their face as they focus on their task. The drawing portrays a sense of solitude and diligence, with detailed clothing folds and shadowing.

artworks.title: Young Artist with a Statue of Cupid
artworks.description: The image shows a young person seated on a wooden chair, facing sideways, with their head bent and resting on their hand. The person is reading an open book, wearing a long coat or robe, with a slightly tousled hairstyle. Next to them are various sculptural elements, including an unfinished cherub-like figure. The background displays a dark wall with fabric or papers on a shelf.

artworks.title: Study for "Surprise" (Battle of the Tigers)
artworks.description: The image shows swirling lines and shapes creating an abstract composition. Some outlines suggest forms of horses and human figures in a dynamic scene reminiscent of a battle or chase. The interwoven figures give an impression of movement and energy, some shapes resembling horse bodies and riders. The abstract artwork invites the viewer to explore the forms amidst the tangle of lines.

artworks.title: Femmes s'essuyant (Women Drying Themselves)
Sunflowers, Rue des Beaux-Arts
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate building façade. The drawing depicts a section of a building with architectural details such as archways and columns. The intricate design highlights a textured surface, creating an impression of depth and complexity. The building appears to have multiple arched windows or doorways, surrounded by decorative elements. The artistry involves fine lines and shading that evoke a sense of both intricate craftsmanship and a dynamic street scene atmosphere. The scene feels busy and crowded with details.

artworks.title: Figures in a Storm
artworks.medium: brush and brown ink with brown wash, heightened with white, over red chalk on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. William T. Hassett, Jr.
artworks.description: This is a drawing of abstract scene with dynamically posed figures. The drawing features multiple figures in a limited palette of shades of brown and touches of blue. The figures appear to be in motion, with swirling lines suggesting movement and energy. The overall style conveys drama and emotion, capturing an action-filled narrative without a specific setting or context.

artworks.title: Landscape with the Penitence of Saint Jerome
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: This drawing shows a vast landscape with hills dotted with trees, grazing animals, and small buildings. In the distance on the right is a walled collection of buildings that may be a town or city. The vague outlines of people walk on a path in front of the wall. Closer to us, on the left, is a tall tree. At its base seems to be a kneeling man with a long beard. He is drawn with loose lines, and few details are visible. Next to him is an animal lying on the ground that looks like a lion, or perhaps a dog. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark brown ink on beige paper.

artworks.title: Adonis
artworks.medium: black chalk with white chalk heightening on blue paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person standing on one leg with the other leg bent and slightly raised. The individual has one hand resting across the chest, and the head is tilted downward. The facial features are soft, with a serene expression, and the hair is curly, framing the face delicately. The person is not wearing any clothing. The background consists of a textured, somewhat indistinct environment, with darker shading around the figure, possibly representing foliage or abstract forms against a light-colored canvas. The image has a monochromatic appearance, executed in shades of gray on a bluish-gray paper.

artworks.title: Venus
artworks.medium: black chalk with white chalk heightening on blue-gray paper

artworks.title: Portrait of an Ecclesiastic Wearing a Biretta
artworks.dimensions:
Overall (approximate): 31.6 x 22.4 cm (12 7/16 x 8 13/16 in.)
support: 39.8 x 30.8 cm (15 11/16 x 12 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts a detailed portrait drawing of a man. He is positioned in a three-quarter view, showing a clear side profile. The man has sharp facial features, including prominent cheekbones, a straight nose, and a slightly squared-off jaw. He has short hair and wears a cap or hat. His expression is neutral, with facial hair visible. The man is wearing a garment that covers his neck and shoulders, with a noticeable drape on his shoulder. The background is plain and lightly textured, adding depth to the portrait.

artworks.title: Head of a Faun in a Concave Roundel
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a man's face in a circular frame. The man's head fills most of the composition. His head is slightly tilted to the left. He has distinct facial features including deep-set eyes, a prominent nose, a full beard and mustache, and curly hair. The circular frame is decorated with leafy vines and grapes. The sketch is in brown ink on aged paper with visible marks and stains. There is no background in the image.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child Appearing to Saints George and William
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over black  chalk on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
Overall: 27.7 x 20.9 cm (10 7/8 x 8 1/4 in.)
support: 34.6 x 28 cm (13 5/8 x 11 in.)
artworks.description: The image depicts four figures. Two standing figures in the foreground are displayed in full, while the central pair on a cloud are in three-quarter view. The central figures include a woman seated on a cloud, holding a child on her lap. The woman's head is turned slightly to the side, with soft features and hair depicted with subtle lines. She appears draped in a flowing cloth. The child she holds is unclothed, with curly hair, and is reaching towards her. On either side, there are two fully armored male figures, one with his back mostly turned towards the viewer and the other facing slightly towards the woman. Both are wearing elaborate armor and helmets, and one is holding a banner or flag. The setting is suggested by clouds and a hint of trees in the background, giving the impression of a heavenly scene. The drawing has a sepia tone.

artworks.title: Caricature of the Laocoon Group
artworks.artist: Attributed to Niccolò Boldrini after Titian
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three monkeys entangled with several snakes in a dynamic scene. The central monkey is caught in a large snake's coil, with two other monkeys also entangled. The background includes textured tree, hills, and a village with distinct architectural features like a steeple. The sky is filled with expressive lines adding drama to the scene. The artwork emphasizes the struggle between the creatures.

artworks.title: The Madonna and Child in Glory with Saints Gregory the Great and Andrew
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with gray wash over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of religious figures with angelic presences. The top part shows figures placed on clouds, including a woman holding an infant. Surrounding the figures are angel-like beings, one holding a flowing drapery. Below, another male figure with a beard is portrayed holding a large object, possibly a column, while a smaller child figure stands next to him. The composition features intricate line work and shading, creating a sense of depth and movement.

artworks.title: Pool at the Edge of a Wood
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and brush and brown ink over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective, with a wooded scene. Twisted trees frame the composition. The horizon is high in the image, showing hills and a structure resembling a castle. The central part is dominated by dense foliage. The artist uses a monochromatic palette of sepia tones with varied brushstrokes to suggest texture within the trees and foliage.

artworks.title: The Temptation of Christ by the Devil
artworks.artist: Christoffel Jegher after Sir Peter Paul Rubens
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures in a natural landscape. The seated figure has a halo and is gesturing towards the standing figure. The scene includes detailed foliage and rocks, set in nature. The use of lines and shading adds depth and texture, typical of etching or engraving techniques. The composition is framed by trees and plants.
